question: Who seated lowest, seeing ever-higher excellence, is fate-burnt?
premises: in the lowest, who in place
therefore who else would be fate-burnt
inference: Low-seated seers of higher fortune are fate-burnt — who else?
uncertainties: daiva-dagdhaka reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: Seeing higher-and-higher excellence-fortune, yet situated in the lowest — who in place? Therefore who else would be fate-burnt?
